killers.name: The Trapper
killers.powerDescription: Place traps that immobilize Survivors and reveal them when triggered.

killers.name: The Wraith
killers.powerDescription: Cloak to become invisible with no Terror Radius and gain speed. Uncloak to attack.

killers.name: The Hillbilly
killers.powerDescription: Sprint forward with a chainsaw to instantly down Survivors.

killers.name: The Nurse
killers.powerDescription: Blink through obstacles and attack before entering fatigue.

killers.name: The Shape
killers.powerDescription: Stalk Survivors to increase tiers. Tier I: 0m TR, Tier II: 16m, Tier III: 32m with instant downs.

killers.name: The Hag
killers.powerDescription: Place traps and teleport to triggered ones.

killers.name: The Doctor
killers.powerDescription: Shock Survivors to disrupt actions and build Madness.

killers.name: The Huntress
killers.powerDescription: Throw hatchets to damage Survivors at range.

killers.name: The Cannibal
killers.powerDescription: Perform sweeping chainsaw attacks hitting multiple Survivors.

killers.name: The Nightmare
killers.powerDescription: Pull Survivors into the Dream World and control the map with snares or pallets.

killers.name: The Pig
killers.powerDescription: Use stealth and traps that force Survivors to search boxes.

killers.name: The Clown
killers.powerDescription: Throw gas bottles to slow Survivors or boost yourself.

killers.name: The Spirit
killers.powerDescription: Phase invisibly and track Survivors using audio cues.

killers.name: The Legion
killers.powerDescription: Sprint and apply Deep Wound to multiple Survivors.

killers.name: The Plague
killers.powerDescription: Infect Survivors and gain a stronger ranged attack when empowered.

killers.name: The Ghost Face
killers.powerDescription: Become undetectable and expose Survivors by stalking.

killers.name: The Oni
killers.powerDescription: Absorb blood to activate a powerful dash and instant-down attack.

killers.name: The Deathslinger
killers.powerDescription: Shoot and reel in Survivors with a harpoon.

killers.name: The Executioner
killers.powerDescription: Torment Survivors and send them to cages.

killers.name: The Blight
killers.powerDescription: Rush and bounce off obstacles for lethal attacks.

killers.name: The Twins
killers.powerDescription: Control Victor to hunt while Charlotte remains behind.

killers.name: The Trickster
killers.powerDescription: Throw blades rapidly to injure Survivors.

killers.name: The Nemesis
killers.powerDescription: Infect Survivors and use tentacle strikes while zombies apply pressure.

killers.name: The Artist
killers.powerDescription: Send crows to damage and reveal Survivors.

killers.name: The Dredge
killers.powerDescription: Teleport between lockers and trigger Nightfall.

killers.name: The Skull Merchant
killers.powerDescription: Deploy drones to track and weaken Survivors.

killers.name: The Unknown
killers.powerDescription: Apply hallucinations and teleport to affected Survivors.

killers.name: The Cenobite
killers.powerDescription: Control chains and trigger chain hunts.

killers.name: The Onryo
killers.powerDescription: Teleport via TVs and build Condemned.

killers.name: The Mastermind
killers.powerDescription: Dash and slam Survivors to infect them.

killers.name: The Knight
killers.powerDescription: Summon guards to patrol and chase Survivors.

killers.name: The Singularity
killers.powerDescription: Use biopods to track and teleport to Survivors.

killers.name: The Xenomorph
killers.powerDescription: Use tunnels for mobility and tail attacks in chase.

killers.name: The Good Guy
killers.powerDescription: Use stealth and fast dash attacks.

killers.name: The Lich
killers.powerDescription: Grants access to four distinct spells: Mage Hand, Flight of the Damned, Dispelling Sphere, and Fly.

killers.name: The Dark Lord
killers.powerDescription: Shapeshifts between Vampire (standard), Wolf (tracking and pouncing), and Bat (stealth and teleportation) forms.

killers.name: The Houndmaster
killers.powerDescription: Commands a hound to trail Survivors, hinder their movement by grabbing their leg.

killers.name: The Ghoul
killers.powerDescription: Chains leap attacks and enters enraged mode.

killers.name: The Animatronic
killers.powerDescription: Throw axe.

killers.name: The Krasue
killers.powerDescription: Separates head and body to move freely.

killers.name: The First
killers.powerDescription: Moves in another dimension and attacks from below.
